title: Perfect direct image of a bounded coherent relative finite-Tor complex on spaces
statement: Work with a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], algebraic spaces over $S$ and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], quasi-coherent modules [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], and the canonical module functors [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Derived pullback and tensor are computed with K-flat resolutions with flat terms, and derived direct image with K-injective resolutions. Perfect means etale locally isomorphic in the derived category to a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free structure modules. Finite presentation of a morphism means quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally finitely presented on etale scheme charts. A module is finitely presented when it locally has a presentation $\mathcal O^m\to\mathcal O^n\to M\to0$ with $m,n$ finite. Flatness over a base is flatness of geometric stalks over its corresponding geometric local rings. Proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed; the scheme theoretic support of a finitely presented module is the closed subspace cut out by its annihilator. Let $Y$ be a Noetherian algebraic space, meaning quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts. Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type and quasi-separated; no properness or quasi-compactness of $f$ is assumed. Let $H\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology sheaves, meaning quasi-coherent and finitely generated on Noetherian affine etale charts, and suppose $H^i(H)=0$ outside a single finite interval of integers. Suppose the closed geometric-stalk support of each $H^i(H)$ is proper over $Y$, meaning that its reduced induced closed subspace, the closed subspace of $X$ with that point set whose etale scheme charts are reduced, is proper over $Y$. Assume the scalar restriction of $H$ along $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ has finite Tor dimension: there are integers $a\le b$ such that for every sheaf $F$ of $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-modules, $H\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}F[0]$ has cohomology zero outside $[a,b]$. Then $Rf_*H$ is perfect in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$.

source.place: Tag 08IS (lemma-perfect-direct-image), statement; proper closed support is Tag 0CZC (lemma-closed-proper-over-base) and definition-proper-over-base.

proof.text: Put $K=Rf_*H$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-proper-support-bounded-coherent-image] to the given locally finite-type $f$, Noetherian $Y$, bounded coherent $H$ and proper cohomological supports. Thus $K$ has bounded coherent cohomology; choose $c\in\mathbf Z$ with $H^i(K)=0$ for $i>c$. By [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-pseudocoherent-criterion], $K$ is pseudo-coherent. No properness or quasi-compactness of $f$ has been introduced.

Fix a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module $F$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-proper-support-derived-projection-formula] under the same hypotheses and the given quasi-separatedness. It identifies $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_Y}F[0]$ with $Rf_*J_F$, where $J_F=H\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}(f^{-1}F)[0]$, with its structure-module action through $H$. The given relative Tor interval $[a,b]$ applies to the module sheaf $f^{-1}F$, hence $H^q(J_F)=0$ outside $[a,b]$.

The module categories of the chosen small ringed sites are Grothendieck abelian by [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian]. The canonical $f_*$ is a right adjoint by [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], hence additive left exact. Apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to a good lower truncation representing $J_F$. Its spectral sequence $R^pf_*H^q(J_F)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(Rf_*J_F)$ has $p\ge0$ and $q\ge a$. For $n<a$ there are no terms of total degree $n$, so its finite exhaustive separated abutment filtration gives $H^n(Rf_*J_F)=0$. This lower bound is the same for every $F$.

source.place: Tag 08IS (lemma-perfect-direct-image), proof; final sentence, expanded via the bounded-below hypercohomology spectral sequence.

proof.text: Set $A=\min(a,c)$. The preceding comparison and vanishing show $H^i(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}F[0])=0$ for every quasi-coherent $F$ and every $i<A$. Since $Y$ is quasi-separated by its Noetherian hypothesis, $K$ has quasi-coherent cohomology and upper bound $c$, and $A\le c$, [lem-sfb-space-quasicoherent-tor-amplitude-test] gives Tor amplitude $[A,c]$ against all module sheaves.

source.place: Tag 08IS (lemma-perfect-direct-image), proof; Tag 08IL, quasi-coherent tensor tests.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-ringed-site-perfect-criterion] to the small etale ringed model of $Y$. Step 1 gives precisely its pseudo-coherence condition, and step 4 gives finite Tor dimension, hence also locally finite Tor dimension. The criterion therefore makes $K$ locally isomorphic in the derived category to a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free structure modules. This is the perfectness asserted.
